disk.scopeHint: Only folders you share through the picker are scanned. Files are never changed; symbolic links are not followed.
disk.permission: Folder analysis needs files:pick and storage:usage.read, plus a role allowed to read files. An administrator can grant app permissions in the App Store.
disk.metricsPermission: Storage information needs system:metrics.read and a role allowed to read system data.
disk.emptyHint: EveryOS remembers your shared folder until its access is revoked.
disk.lost: The shared folder is no longer available. Choose it again to restore access.
disk.scanHint: Logical file sizes, not allocated disk blocks. Up to 50,000 entries, 32 nested levels and a 15-second traversal budget; listings have their own timeouts.
disk.partial: Partial scan: limits were reached or some folders could not be read. Sizes are lower bounds. This result is not added to trends.
disk.largestHint: Up to 50 measured files; paths are relative to the current folder.
disk.typesHint: Up to 50 extensions, ordered by measured size. Extensions describe names, not verified content.
disk.mountHint: File-system usage includes reserved space, metadata and other folders. Mounts may share the same storage; do not add them together. Host results may be cached for 15 seconds.
disk.name: Name
disk.stale: Refresh failed. The previous snapshot remains visible with its retrieval time.

trend.title: Measured storage trend
trend.hint: Up to 24 observations per scope and 8 scopes are kept in this app. Refreshes within 15 seconds replace one observation. Only complete folder scans enter the trend.
trend.empty: At least two measurements at different times are needed to show a trend.

source.simulatedHint: These values are simulated by the development host and do not describe the real host.
